name: skill-shelf
description: Stable, locally installable research, writing, explanation, and mathematical visualization skills.

plugins.name: academic-writing
plugins.description: Compose and review scholarly abstracts, expository introductions, explanations, figures, prose, terminology, notation, evidence, and sentence-level revisions.

plugins.name: physics-paper
plugins.description: Draft, revise, and audit physics research-paper introductions against the manuscript, literature, intended readership, and target venue.

plugins.name: nogap
plugins.description: Detect, repair, and verify reader-facing gaps in rigorous explanations.

plugins.name: manim
plugins.description: Create and verify source-grounded mathematical animations with Manim.

plugins.name: research-workflow
plugins.description: Coordinate theoretical-physics research with bounded roles, independent checks, and durable handoff.

plugins.name: study-notes
plugins.description: Create and revise scholarly study notes with optional HTML manuscript conventions.

plugins.name: ai-bias
plugins.description: Recognize and correct recurring biases in AI reasoning, evidence use, writing, and revision.

plugins.name: speech-act
plugins.description: Instructional guidance for planning, revising, and evaluating scholarly writing through speech-act distinctions, with bounded use of language models.
